# FDG9127

> DO perform argument and state validation in the nonvirtual member of the Template Method Pattern before calling the virtual member.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.9 Template Method.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test none
- Status: verified

The text has no body; the body of FDG9128 gives the reason for both. Not library only: that reason, bugs from argument validation that differs or is missing in a derived type, holds for class hierarchies in any code. Not machine-checkable: which checks are common to all implementations is what the arguments and states mean, and the validation can be in a called helper.
